prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent 2.5D infantry formation sprite for a Japanese grand-strategy map.
Input images: Image 1 is an ORIGINAL fictional castle miniature style reference only. Do not draw or reproduce a castle. Use the same finely hand-painted material realism, soft high oblique camera and restrained colors.
Primary request: one compact formation of eight generic Japanese spear infantry marching toward SCREEN RIGHT (east). Every soldier's body and head clearly faces right; show right-facing profiles, never a frontal portrait. Staggered ranks create miniature depth, with all complete feet visible.
Style/medium: believable hand-painted miniature soldiers, muted charcoal and blue-grey lamellar armor, simple iron helmets with neck guards, olive-grey clothing, small natural skin tones and worn wood spear shafts. Refined tiny military formation, not flat vector, chibi, toy or low-poly. Generic original fictional troops, no exact historic clan identity or named heroes.
Composition: one centered compact unit on a square genuinely transparent canvas, high oblique overhead view around 55 degrees. Three staggered ranks, feet form a shallow oval centered near lower middle; short controlled gaps between soldiers. Spears mostly upright and entirely visible. Entire group has transparent margins. Cohesive readable broad masses that remain legible at a small map scale.
Lighting: fixed soft NORTHWEST light from image upper left, darker lower-right material planes, tiny contact shadows beneath feet. Do not rotate lighting with marching direction.
Constraints: infantry only, no horses, guns, flags, banners, poles without spearheads, insignia, text, UI, numbers, watermark, castle, ground tile, baseplate, landscape, sky or background. No large shadow blob. Exactly one east-facing formation, not a sheet or multiple views. Compact square sprite below 2048 pixels per side.
